description: Check the verification and DKIM status of a sending domain in your AWS SES account. Returns whether the domain is verified for sending and its DKIM configuration status.

domain.description: Domain to check, e.g. example.com. SES identities are per-region.

name: verify_domain_status

dkimStatus.description: SES DKIM status, e.g. SUCCESS, PENDING, FAILED.

dkimTokens.description: CNAME tokens to publish in DNS.

region.description: SES identities are per-region; this is the region checked.

verified.description: True when SES will accept sends from this domain.
